description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the AccessControlList interface, representing an access control list for authorization purposes. It provides methods for creating, merging, setting, and removing ACL entries, as well as checking permissions and serializing to JSON. The class is marked as deprecated, indicating it belongs to an older API version.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlList
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the AccessControlList interface, providing thread-safe, read-only access to ACL entries, with methods for creating, merging, updating, and serialization.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a new empty Access Control List (ACL).

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ACL initialized with specified entries.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ACL instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges an AclEntry, AuthorizationSubject with permissions, or permissions with subjects into the ACL, returning a new ACL instance.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets or replaces an ACL entry, returning a new ACL if modified.

methods.name: setForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets permissions for all authorization subjects.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor
methods.description: Retrieves subjects authorized for specific permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the provided authorization context has the specified permission.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if a specific authorization subject has the specified permission.

methods.name: getPermissionsOf
methods.description: Retrieves permissions of a given authorization subject.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an ACL entry, returning a new ACL if modified.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes specific permissions from a subject's ACL entry.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions for a given authorization subject.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACL is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the ACL.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a set of all ACL entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of ACL entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the ACL entries.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL into a JSON object with optional filtering.
